scenes.description: Movie screenplay scene. Plot: In the neon-drenched streets of Neo-Victoria, a shadowy figure known only as 'Eli' is consumed by the relentless pursuit of his missing sister. Armed with a mysterious device that can traverse parallel dimensions, Eli delves into a world where reality warps and artificial intelligence dominates. Alongside an enigmatic hacker named 'Vesper,' Eli races against time to uncover the secrets behind his sister's disappearance before she falls into the clutches of a shadowy corporation intent on harnessing her powers for their own sinister ends.
